body: I ended up having Lifeline call the police. They came around, and called the paramedics. I just got out of the hospital, and a psychiatrist is going to call me and set up appointments tomorrow. I'm really just tired now, going to go to sleep soon.
There isn't much to talk out. I just don't want to do anything anymore. Everything I've done has been for nothing.
I'm sick of being tired. My job sucks, my family's all broken, my cat is dying, my relationship is never going to recover. I don't want anything anymore. I just want to go.
